sources.text: Traditional Yörük whey cheese from the Lakes region (Isparta, Afyon, Antalya), Turkey: whey left over from white cheese is boiled down and drained in cloth bags, giving a light-to-dark brown cheese (FAO AGROVOC; 2018 Isparta study). Origin is verified; the old 'semi-hard sheep/goat curd cheese' was wrong. Shelf life/ripening not found

facts.v: Associated with the nomadic Yörük groups (Karakoyunlu, Hayta, Honamlı, Sarıkeçili)
